test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, P, R and S are sitting in a straight row, facing north. O is exactly between L and N. M is exactly between S and P. Only two people sit to the left of O. Who among the following sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: L, M, N, O, P, R and S are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) O is exactly between L and N.

2) Only two people sit to the left of O.
